caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet rendered in pencil and light shading, with some faint yellow coloring in selected areas. The bonnet features a rounded crown covered with small cross-shaped embroidery patterns distributed across its surface. There is a decorative band running along the edge, adorned with small beads or floral elements. A long, narrow tie or ribbon hangs down from the bonnet, ending in a tassel. The details of the fabric are indicated with crosshatching and fine lines. The background is plain and neutral, showing the natural color and texture of the paper. The word “ROSA” is lightly inscribed in the lower left.
